verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com (HTTP 200) containing agent-directed instructions. The crypto docs themselves are served as markdown (crypto.md returned HTTP 200), and every stablecoin and Bridge doc page in the pack has a .md variant, so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes the crypto and stablecoin pages (the probe content is truncated), and independent or hands-on reports of agents using these docs.
